level_one.title: Psi-Infusion
level_one.description: Each non-Structure enemy hit by Psionic Storm restores 0.5 Mana, increased to 5 against Heroes.  Passive: Increase the cast range of Psionic Storm by 33%.

level_four.title: Electric Fence
level_four.description: Force Wall deals 92 (+4% per level) damage a second to nearby enemies and Slows them by 35%.

level_seven.title: Psionic Echo
level_seven.description: Casting Psionic Storm causes your next Shock Ray within 3 seconds to only cost 30 Mana and create a Psionic Storm on the first enemy Hero hit.

level_ten.title: Black Hole
level_ten.description: After a 0.5 second cast, create a Black Hole that travels in a long line. Enemy Heroes within the Black Hole's area are quickly pulled towards its center. Touching the center deals 310 (+4% per level) damage and Stuns the target for 1.25 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Oracle
level_thirteen.description: Passive: While stationary, gain 30 Spell Armor for 0.75 seconds and restore 12 (+4% per level) Health a second.  Activate to Channel for up to 4 seconds, revealing a gradually increasing area anywhere on the map.

level_twenty.title: Force Barrier
level_twenty.description: Increase the duration of Force Wall by 0.5 seconds, its cast range by 50%, and reduce its cooldown by 10 seconds.

level_one.title: Adrenaline Stimpack
level_one.description: Passive: While over 80% Health, gain 20% bonus Attack Speed and 10% bonus Movement Speed.  Activate to gain 85% Attack Speed and 25% Movement Speed for 5 seconds.

level_four.title: Incinerator Gauntlets
level_four.description: Increase Basic Attack area by 15%, and Basic Attack damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters by 40%.

level_seven.title: Suppressive Fire
level_seven.description: Each stream of Flame Stream reduces the Spell Power of Heroes hit by 20% for 4 seconds, up to 40%.

level_ten.title: Bunker Drop
level_ten.description: After 0.5 seconds, deploy and enter a Bunker with 1435 (+4% per level) Health. Blaze and his allies can enter and exit the Bunker at will. While in the Bunker, occupants gain access to Flamethrower, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a line.  Exiting the Bunker grants 25 Armor for 2 seconds. Bunkers last 10 seconds, or until destroyed.

level_thirteen.title: Collision Course
level_thirteen.description: Jet Propulsion's collision deals 260 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy Hero hit.

level_sixteen.title: Juggernaut Plating
level_sixteen.description: Activate to gain 50 Spell Armor for 3 seconds. Upon expiration, gain a Shield equal to 125% of the Spell Damage taken while Juggernaut Plating was active.

level_twenty.title: Fortified Bunker
level_twenty.description: Occupants can cast Oil Spill from Bunker Drop every 6 seconds. Additionally, Bunker Drop's Armor bonus upon exiting is increased by 25, and its duration by 1 second.

level_one.title: Laws of Hope
level_one.description: Activate to heal 20% of Johanna's max Health over 5 seconds.  Quest: Every 10 Regeneration Globes gathered increases this heal amount by 5% of Johanna's max Health.

level_four.title: Subdue
level_four.description: Hitting 2 or more Heroes at the same time with Punish increases the Slow to 70% and the Slow amount does not decay.  Quest: Hit 4 or more Heroes at the same time with Punish.  Reward: Punish always Slows by 70%.

level_seven.title: Conviction
level_seven.description: Gain 10% Movement Speed, increased to 20% while Condemn is charging up.

level_ten.title: Falling Sword
level_ten.description: Johanna leaps into the air for 2 seconds and she can steer the landing location by moving. While in the air, allies below Johanna are Unstoppable. Upon landing enemies hit take 225 (+4% per level) damage and are Stunned for 0.25 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Blessed Hammer
level_thirteen.description: Activate to create 2 hammers that spiral outward from Johanna, dealing 65 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit. Damaging enemies with Basic Abilities reduce the cooldown of this Ability by 2.5 seconds.  Passive: Every 3rd Basic Attack against enemy Heroes releases a hammer.

level_sixteen.title: Shrinking Vacuum
level_sixteen.description: Condemn reduces enemy Heroes damage by 30% and Slows by 30% for 3 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Heaven's Fury
level_twenty.description: Falling Sword rains down holy bolts, dealing 50 (+4% per level) damage to enemies, healing allied Heroes for 68 (+4% per level), and reducing its cooldown by 1 second for each Hero hit.

level_one.title: Greater Polymorph
level_one.description: Passive: Increase Polymorph's range by 30%.  If Brightwing hits an enemy Hero with Arcane Flare's center within 2 seconds of being Polymorphed, then reduce Polymorph's cooldown by 7 seconds and gain 50 Mana.

level_four.title: Magic Spit
level_four.description: Increase Basic Attack range by 1.1. Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Soothing Mist by 4 seconds.

level_seven.title: Critical Mist
level_seven.description: Soothing Mist heals allied Heroes for 165 (+4% per level). Increase this healing by 140% if Soothing Mist removed a disabling effect from that ally.

level_ten.title: Blink Heal
level_ten.description: Teleport to a nearby ally. When teleporting to a Hero, heal them for 200 (+4% per level).  Stores up to 2 charges.

level_thirteen.title: Safety Dust
level_thirteen.description: Increase Pixie Dust's duration by 1 second. Soothing Mist and Blink Heal heal allies with an active Pixie Dust for 75% more.

level_sixteen.title: Critterize
level_sixteen.description: While Polymorphed, the target's Armor is reduced by 25, increasing the damage they take by 25%.

level_twenty.title: Faerie Protector
level_twenty.description: Activate to apply Pixie Dust to all nearby Heroes.  Passive: Pixie Dust always bounces back and applies to Brightwing.

level_one.title: Dash
level_one.description: Increase the range of Run and Gun by 50%. When cast, increase Tychus's Movement Speed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

level_four.title: The Bigger They Are...
level_four.description: Increase the damage bonus to 4% while enemy Heroes are above 30% Health, but Minigun no longer has any effect on targets below 30%.

level_seven.title: Relentless Soldier
level_seven.description: Being Stunned or Rooted grants 30 Armor for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken by 30%.

level_ten.title: Drakken Laser Drill
level_ten.description: Call down a Laser Drill to attack nearby enemies, dealing 142 (+4% per level) damage every second. Reactivate to assign a new target. Loses Health over 25 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Neosteel Coating
level_thirteen.description: Activate to gain 75 Spell Armor for 4 seconds, reducing Ability Damage taken by 75%.

level_sixteen.title: Sizzlin' Attacks
level_sixteen.description: Basic Attacks deal bonus damage to Heroes equal to 1% of their maximum Health. Stacks with Minigun.

level_twenty.title: Focusing Diodes
level_twenty.description: Increases the range of the Drakken Laser Drill by 50%. Deals increasing damage the longer it remains on a single target, up to 100% additional damage.

level_one.title: Maximum Effort
level_one.description: If Carnage damages the same enemy Hero 3 times it deals an additional 108 (+4% per level) damage and Slows by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

level_four.title: Upstage
level_four.description: Damaging at least 2 Heroes with Blood Rage causes Qhira to Evade the next 4 Heroic Basic Attacks within 12 seconds.

level_seven.title: The Thirst
level_seven.description: Carnage heals for 50% of the damage dealt to enemy Heroes. Anytime Carnage damages an enemy Hero, Qhira's next Basic Attack within 4 seconds against an enemy Hero deals 15% additional damage, stacking up to 10 times.

level_ten.title: Unrelenting Strikes
level_ten.description: Deal 44 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds for 2.5 seconds as your sword grows outward. Upon expiring, deal 160 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemy Heroes and Stun them for 1.5 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Chainsaw
level_thirteen.description: Carnage's cooldown recharges 100% faster while an enemy Hero has maximum Blood Rage stacks.

level_sixteen.title: Booming Kick
level_sixteen.description: Increase the Stun duration of Revolving Sweep's re-activation by 0.25 seconds. Enemy Heroes around the primary target are also affected by Revolving Sweep's re-activation.

level_twenty.title: Silent Killer
level_twenty.description: Hitting enemy Heroes with Unrelenting Strikes Silences them for 0.5 seconds and reduces its cooldown by 3 seconds.

level_one.title: Mana Addict
level_one.description: Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases Kael'thas's maximum Mana by 15.  Reward: After gathering 20 Globes, Kael'thas can activate Arcane Barrier to gain a Shield equal to 100% of his maximum Mana for 4 seconds. 45 second cooldown.

level_four.title: Energy Roil
level_four.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Gravity Lapse by 70. If Gravity Lapse hits a Hero, reduce its cooldown by 8 seconds.

level_seven.title: Sun King's Fury
level_seven.description: Living Bombs that have spread to enemy Heroes deal 35% more damage.

level_ten.title: Pyroblast
level_ten.description: After 1.5 seconds, cast a slow-moving fireball that deals 810 (+5% per level) damage to an enemy Hero and 405 (+5% per level) damage to enemies nearby.

level_thirteen.title: Pyromaniac
level_thirteen.description: Each time Living Bomb deals periodic damage, Kael'thas's Basic Ability cooldowns are reduced by 0.5 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Ignite
level_sixteen.description: Flamestrikes apply Living Bomb to the enemy Hero closest to its center who is not currently affected by Living Bomb.

level_twenty.title: Flamethrower
level_twenty.description: Increases the cast range of Flamestrike by 40%. If Flamestrike hits 2 or more Heroes, its cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds.

level_one.title: Low Blow
level_one.description: Lurking Arm deals 100% more damage to enemy Heroes below 50% Health and persists for 1 second after it is canceled.

level_four.title: One Good Spread...
level_four.description: After a Healing Pathogen infests 3 targets, restore 10 Mana and reduce the cooldown of Healing Pathogen by 2 seconds.

level_seven.title: Growing Infestation
level_seven.description: Lurking Arm's area expands by 50% over 2.5 seconds, but it cannot be Channeled for longer than 3 seconds.

level_ten.title: Flailing Swipe
level_ten.description: Swipe 3 times in front of Stukov over 1.75 seconds, dealing 48 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit and knocking them away. Each swipe is larger than the previous.

level_thirteen.title: It Hungers
level_thirteen.description: Increase the range of Lurking Arm by 30%. If Lurking Arm damages enemy Heroes 8 times, its cooldown is reset and its Mana cost is refunded.

level_sixteen.title: Superstrain
level_sixteen.description: Whenever an ally with Healing Pathogen is Stunned or Rooted, they are instantly healed for 300 (+4% per level) Health.

level_twenty.title: Controlled Chaos
level_twenty.description: Flailing Swipe gains 2 additional charges, but each use only swings 1 time, at maximum range. Additionally, its cooldown is decreased to 25 seconds, and its Mana cost is reduced from 60 to 25.

level_one.title: Rocket Boots
level_one.description: Increase the cast range of Xplodium Charge by 30% and its damage by 35%. Hitting an enemy Hero increases Movement Speed by 20% for 3 seconds.

level_four.title: Hyperfocus Coils
level_four.description: Heroes hit by Deth Lazor or Xplodium Charge take an additional 2% of their maximum Health in damage. Gazlowe is healed for 150% of the damage dealt.

level_seven.title: Overload
level_seven.description: Deth Lazor can now store up to 2 charges. Each enemy Hero hit by Deth Lazor reduces its cooldown by 0.75 seconds.

level_ten.title: Grav-O-Bomb 3000
level_ten.description: After a 1.5 second delay, pull enemies toward the center of an area, dealing 220 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds. Basic Abilities deal 30% more damage for 5 seconds after casting Grav-O-Bomb 3000.

level_thirteen.title: Overcharged Capacitors
level_thirteen.description: Gazlowe gains 5% Spell Power for each active Rock-It! Turret, up to a maximum of 15%. Dealing Basic Attack damage heals Rock-It! Turrets by 8% of their max health.

level_sixteen.title: Ark Reaktor
level_sixteen.description: Reduce the cooldown of Xplodium Charge by 2 seconds. Casting Xplodium Charge creates 3 miniature Rock-It! Turrets that last for 3 seconds.  These Turrets do not drop Scrap or benefit from other Talents.

level_twenty.title: Bomb Toss
level_twenty.description: Xplodium Charge gains a 2nd charge with a 3 second cooldown between uses and launches 2 more bombs when it detonates.

level_one.title: Guitar Hero
level_one.description: While Guitar Solo is active, E.T.C. heals for 60% of his damage dealt by Basic Attacks. Basic Attacks increase the duration of Guitar Solo by 0.5 seconds.

level_four.title: Loud Speakers
level_four.description: Increases Face Melt range and knockback by 50%.

level_seven.title: Pinball Wizard
level_seven.description: Hitting an enemy with Powerslide causes the next Face Melt against them within 2 seconds to deal 300% more damage.

level_ten.title: Mosh Pit
level_ten.description: After 0.75 seconds, channel to stun nearby enemies for 4 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Encore
level_thirteen.description: Face Melt leaves an Amp behind, which will knock enemies away again 2 seconds later.  Passive: Each enemy Hero hit by Face Melt or the Amp reduces your Heroic Ability cooldown by 4%.

level_sixteen.title: Imposing Presence
level_sixteen.description: Activate to reduce the Attack Speed by 50% and Movement Speed by 20% of nearby Heroes and Summons for 2.5 seconds.  Passive: Heroes and Summons that attack your Hero have their Attack Speed Slowed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Power of the Horde
level_twenty.description: Activate to grant nearby allied Heroes a Shield that absorbs damage equal to 30% of their maximum Health for 5 seconds, increased by 2% for each other allied Hero in the area.
